about: Measures of a generated pool from origin/design/integration d167cc4 (576 designs: 11 types x 16 biome cultures x s1d1, s2d2, s3d3, homes two seeds, tries 1), taken with the same miners the corpus files came from: lab/mine_motifs.js (sites), lab/mine_yards.js (yards, every build), lab/learn_interior.py (rooms), lab/shapes.py (plan, roof, walls, window, gable), the research track mine_culture.js and sort_culture.js (culture-corpus measures) and lib/critic.js. Scripts and commands in docs/handoffs/2026-11-10-design/ideas.md. Byzantine Plains and Mistlands share file names, so the Mistlands designs replaced the Plains ones (576 of 612).
